Habitica is a free habit-building and productivity app that uses retro RPG elements to gamify your tasks and goals.
Use Habitica to help with ADHD, self care, New Year’s resolutions, household chores, work tasks, creative projects, fitness goals, back-to-school routines, and more!

Create an avatar then add tasks, chores, or goals you’d like to work on. When you do something in real life, check it off in the app and receive gold, experience, and items that can be used in-game! 

Features:
• Automatically repeating tasks scheduled for your daily, weekly, or monthly routines
• Flexible habit tracker for tasks you want to do multiple times a day or only once in awhile
• Traditional to do list for tasks that only need to be done once
• Color coded tasks and streak counters help you see how you’re doing at a glance

You are the protagonist. Your life has a character sheet.

Arete is a life RPG for adults: six real stats — Body, Vitality, Mind, Spirit, Presence, Discipline — drawn as a radar that grows from what you actually do. Complete daily quests, earn XP, level up. No avatar. The character is you.

THE CHARACTER SHEET
One glance answers everything: today's quests, your level, your streak, the last seven days, and the shape of your six stats. When you create your character you sketch who you think you are — the dashed Ghost on the radar. Then your earned self chases it, one quest at a time.

DAILY QUESTS, REAL XP
Every completion is a vote for the person you're becoming. Tap the seal when a quest is done — the ink fills, XP lands, the radar moves. Harder practices earn more, and steady weeks build visible momentum. Mis-tapped? Undo it. Edit any quest.

SEAL THE DAY, EARN INK
Finish today's board and the day is sealed. Every day you show up earns Ink, a sealed day earns more, and it dries overnight — earned by days, not by grinding, and never sold. Spend it in your Panoply: six pieces, one per stat, drawn stage by stage.

A WEEKLY BOSS
Take on one stretch a week. Every day you practise its stat wears it down; doing it once wins a dated Stamp. Leave it and it walks off on Sunday — nothing lost. Deeds and curios fill your Codex, and your two strongest stats name your Archetype.

REMINDERS THAT RESPECT YOU
A short morning note with today's quests, and an evening nudge only on a day you haven't started. Complete, Snooze or Skip from the lock screen. Step away and Arete leaves a single note, then goes quiet.

THE JOURNEY
An append-only ledger of your days and a calendar for every quest — the days you showed up, in ink.

A LIBRARY OF PRACTICES
Adopt a routine in one tap — Better Mornings, Deeper Focus, Stronger Body, Calmer Mind, Clear Skin, The Quiet Quit and more — or author your own.

THE CAMPFIRE
Close the week by the fire: the week's XP stat by stat, and one honest line in your own words. The flame burns brighter the more days you showed up.

BUILT ON MERCY
A hard week never empties your radar. Streaks can be patched with repair tokens earned by showing up. Coming back after time away opens a doorway, never a debt. Mercy is never paywalled.

QUIET BY DESIGN
Warm paper, ink, and a single ember accent. No red badges, no shame mechanics, no appearance scoring — ever.

ARETE PRO
The core loop — quests, XP, the radar, streaks, reminders, the Day Seal, Ink and the Panoply, the Campfire — is free forever, with room for two active quests in every stat. Arete Pro adds unlimited quests, a full year of every quest's calendar, your history as a CSV file, real wake-up alarms that ring through Silent and Focus, extra pattern sets for your Panoply, the whole Library without slot math, and clean Character Card exports. Start with a free trial.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No account, no ads. Your quests and history stay on your iPhone.

"For the things we have to learn before we can do them, we learn by doing them."
— Aristotle, Nicomachean Ethics II.1

Create your character in two minutes. Tonight still counts.

results.releaseNotes:
The forge finally looks like a forge.

Every strike lands. Tap a quest and you feel it. The hammer falls with weight, sound and sparks, the reward punches in, and the app gives you the moment. It is the change you will notice first.

The fire on your home screen was rebuilt from scratch. Real flame, drawn live, with a white hot base that cools as it rises and tips that dissolve into the dark. It roars on the days you work and it cools on the days you do not. Show up at all and it stays lit. Disappear for three days and you come back to embers.

The painted artwork is now shown at full size. Challenge cards and story chapters carry it across the whole card instead of a thumbnail, so you can finally see the anvil, the climb and the ore.

Today's Trial gives each day its own character. One rotating modifier, bonus rewards in the discipline it favors, and it never shifts on you partway through the day.

The Wager arrives after a perfect day. Stake coins on holding the line. Double them or burn them.

Loot no longer arrives as a line of text. The slag shudders, cracks open, and the item settles in its rarity color.

Logging stopped asking for your keyboard. Weight and measurements use steppers that open on your last entry. Workouts you have logged before take one tap.

Meditations hold the screen awake, keep the ambient bed under the silence, and close with a real ending instead of cutting out.

Onboarding now finishes with a real quest, a real strike and experience you earned. The tutorial is gone.

We also stopped asking for notification permission before you have even used the app, and removed a coin purchase screen that never worked. Coins are earned here.

results.description:
You've checked the boxes. The day still didn't happen.

Routinery tracks your routines and then runs them with you.

App of the Day 2026 (Apple) - Best ADHD App of 2025 (Forbes Health) - 5 million downloads

A habit tracker, routine tracker and day planner in one. Stack small habits into a daily routine, break it into 1-5 minute steps, and each step runs on its own timer while a voice calls out what comes next.

Morning routines, bedtime wind-downs, study blocks, workouts, medication - anything with a fixed order runs the same way.

WHY IT WORKS
- Starting gets easier. "Study" is too big to begin; "sit at the desk, 1 min" is not. Small steps lower the cost of the first move.
- Nothing to decide mid-run. You set the order once, when you built the routine. Nothing left to choose means less to stall on.
- Wins come back often. A finish is logged every step, not once a day.
- No time math. You set each step's length once. Sink into one thing and the voice pulls you out, so an afternoon doesn't vanish.

ASK CHATGPT OR CLAUDE TO BUILD IT
- "Make me a 40-minute weekday morning routine" and it lands in the app.
- Your assistant can handle routines alongside other tools you've connected there, like Google Calendar.
- Connects to ChatGPT, Claude and others over our MCP server, included in the free plan.

IT STARTS ON TIME, SCREEN OR NOT
- Set the weekdays and time; the reminder arrives then. Weekdays only, three times a week, whatever your schedule.
- The voice reads each step aloud, so the routine keeps running while you shower or cook.
- A home screen widget shows today's list without opening the app.
- Start on the phone, carry on from watch, tablet, or Mac.

STAY DEEP IN ONE THING
- A pomodoro that announces the next task, so the block keeps its own momentum.
- Build the environment: white noise, Focus mode, landscape view, Shortcuts.
- Stretch a timer, skip a step, reorder what's left - all without leaving the run.

DON'T DO IT ALONE
- Share a routine's task list with family or a friend and see how far each of you got.
- Finish a routine and the result goes straight to the person you picked.

SEE IT ADD UP
- A plant grows for each day you keep a streak; weekly and monthly stats show what holds.

FOR THE DAILY AND THE ONE-OFF
- Keep undated tasks and weekly repeats in one daily routine planner.
- A one-time task gets a timer too.
- Can't face it now? Park it in Anytime for later.
- Shift work that moves weekly still fits: Morning, Afternoon, Evening.
- See the day as a list, a calendar, or a timeline.

WHO USES ROUTINERY
- Adults with ADHD who know the task and still can't start
- People who lose hours once they sink into something
- People who double-check in case they missed one
- Anyone who waits to start until they can do it perfectly
- Shift workers, people on daily medication, parents on the school run
- Anyone who wrote a routine down and never once ran it

ROUTINERY AT A GLANCE

Is Routinery free?
Yes. 2 routines free, no account, first one running in under a minute. Premium lifts the routine cap: monthly, 6-month or yearly. The free plan shows ads; Premium is ad-free.

Do I need an account, and what about privacy?
No account, no sign-up. Routine data is stored on our servers; usage analytics go through third-party tools. What you type is never used to train AI models. Email hello@routinery.app and we delete your data.

Does Routinery work offline?
Almost entirely. Routines, timers, voice, reminders and history run offline. Only device sync needs a connection.

What does Routinery connect to?
Siri Shortcuts, widgets, Apple Watch, and AI assistants over MCP. No direct sync with Apple Health or calendars. No export button either; pull your data out over MCP instead, free plan included.

What devices does Routinery run on?
iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. No web version.

Questions, bugs or ideas: hello@routinery.app

Routinery is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat ADHD.

In the realm of Slothbound, a global epidemic of laziness—the Apathy Plague—is sweeping the land. This isn't just about missing deadlines; it's about your hero (you!) slowly succumbing to a lethargic, productivity-destroying virus. Every skipped workout, every late night doom-scrolling session, and every important task left unfinished builds your Lethargy Points (LP).

If your LP meter fills, the virus consumes you. You suffer major in-game setbacks, lose valuable gear, and watch your carefully cultivated progress crumble. Your motivation is literally your health bar.

It’s time to equip your resolve, forge your habits, and become the cure.

Core Features: Turn Tasks into Triumphs
1. The Lethargy vs. Immunity System
The Virus (Lethargy Points - LP): Any deviation from your planned day—missing a scheduled task, hitting the snooze button too many times, or logging excessive "waste" time—increases your LP. Watch the infection spread across your screen as your productivity drops.

The Cure (Immunity Points - IP): Successfully completing a scheduled task, hitting a deep-work goal, or logging a healthy habit instantly grants Immunity Points. Use IP to actively reduce your LP, craft powerful anti-virus gear, or unlock restorative abilities for your hero.

2. Customize Your Hero & Master Your Skills
Your life areas translate directly into your hero's powerful Skill Trees:

Focus Tree (Intellect): Level up by completing study, work, or concentration-heavy tasks. Boosts speed and mental clarity in the game.

Vitality Tree (Health): Advance by tracking exercise, healthy meals, and proper sleep. Grants increased energy and resilience against the virus.

Social Tree (Charisma): Improve through networking, calling friends/family, or contributing to your community. Unlocks powerful group bonuses.

3. Quest-Based To-Do Management
Daily Quests: Your routine tasks are now mission objectives. Successfully completing them awards experience (XP) and IP.

Epic Sagas (Projects): Break down massive, intimidating projects (like writing a thesis or launching a product) into multi-step "Sagas." Completing each step advances the overall storyline and provides immense rewards.

Sloth Lord Boss Battles: Completing major project milestones triggers a Boss Battle. Success depends on having balanced stats across your Skill Trees and consistently defeating your daily tasks leading up to the final confrontation.

Why Slothbound Works (The Anti-Procrastination Loop)
High-Stakes Motivation: Unlike other productivity apps, Slothbound gives procrastination a real, visible consequence. The looming threat of the Apathy Plague (losing progress) is a more potent motivator than just a checkmark.

Gamified Rewards: Every productive action is immediately rewarded with XP, IP, and loot, providing the dopamine hit you need to stay on track.

Visual Deterioration: The app's interface subtly degrades as your LP rises (becoming darker, slower, or fuzzy), providing a constant, stark reminder to get back to work and save your life's "realm."

No Shame, Just Strategy: Slothbound treats laziness as a challenge to be conquered, not a personal failing. It gives you the tools and strategy (the IP system) to fight back and regain control.

Ready to Fight the Good Fight?

results.releaseNotes:
THE JEWELER
A brand new career inside the Celebrity Pack. Buy stones, cut them, set them, and sell them to rappers, queens, nervous proposers and one very rich cat. Grow from your bedroom bench into a House with your name over the door.

Star, the dealer who lies beautifully
Chingy "Star" Rockefeller sells you every stone. Haggle, compliment, or push too hard and he packs up. His mood shows as a word, never a number.

The cut
A timing ring closes on each facet. Tap when it meets the gold band. A perfect facet bursts in prism light with a clink you can feel. A miss can crack the stone.

The bench and the setting
Pick a piece, a metal and a design. Drag each stone into its seat. Where you put them is your design, and some layouts match lost designs.

The reveal
Five quality tiers from Wonky to Legendary, each with its own glow. Legendary is about 1 in 40 for a skilled jeweler: never guaranteed, always possible.

40 lost designs
Find them by experimenting at the bench. The Pattern Book gives a riddle, never the answer. Odile's Pattern Market offers three new patterns each year.

Selling
A 45 second shop rush, counter commissions, wholesale, or a live auction for your Masterpieces and Legendaries.

Customers and comedy
Nine kinds of people walk in: a rapper who wants his mom's name spelled in grillz, a queen after a coronation tiara, a nervous proposer who wants the ring hidden in a croissant, a billionaire's cat who gets a $60,000 emerald collar, and a scammer selling cubic zirconia. Big popups come at most twice a year. Everything else goes to the Life Feed.

The Mother of Diamonds
The rarest find in the game: a 34 carat D Flawless oval, one tier above Legendary. You need a Cutting skill of 100, a Reputation of 80 or more, and a rumor chain from the deepest vein of an Open Mine. About 1 in 3 dynasties find one. Sell it at a record auction, keep it in the family vault, give it to the Crown Jewels, or wear it.

Mines and crews
Work claims from a riverbed pan to a deep shaft. Choose which grades to keep, and hire a foreman. Foreman Gary has 31 years underground.

Connected to your whole life
Proposals, royal commissions, the heist board, fae glamour, vampire clients, witch stones, heirs with trust conditions, and an IPO door at Global Maison.

From a lamp to a landmark
Bedroom Bench, Mall Kiosk, Boutique, The House of (your name), then Global Maison. Each stage has its own rent, vault size and yearly profit.


BUG FIXES:
Family Tree
* Past life relatives' portraits did not age (a cousin at 18 had a toddler face, an in-law at 56 a teen face). Player report from LilG80
* A relative's unmarried co-parent was labeled "In-law" now "Mother of X"
* Blood relatives were sometimes labeled as co-parents or in-laws; blood now wins

Portraits
* Question mark faces fixed: we switched our portrait servers to a faster, more stable setup, so faces load reliably and the question mark avatars no longer appear. As a backup, if a face ever fails to load, the game retries and shows a matching face of the same gender, race and age instead of a broken image. Covers relationship cards, popups and the Edit character row

Self heals with the next update: existing saves repair themselves on load. Broken faces are swapped for ones that load, and past life relatives get faces that match their age. Players do not need to do anything.

Vampires
* Bug: a retired vampire living on a pension could never work a regular job again. Fix: retired vampires can take jobs again; starting one brings them out of retirement and pauses the pension while they work. Player report from Great
* Bug: moving to a new place and starting a career still set off the "it has been forty years and you have not aged" warning, even though nobody there knew you. Fix: the warning and the career suspicion now count only the years people in your current place have known you, starting fresh after every move or new identity

results.description:
Your world has become a fantasy RPG.

Every road leads somewhere. Every walk uncovers adventure. Every landmark could hide a dungeon, a powerful boss, or legendary treasure.

Orna transforms the real world into a living fantasy RPG where exploration, turn-based combat, and deep character progression come together in one unforgettable adventure. Whether you're exploring your neighborhood or travelling somewhere new, every journey becomes part of your story.

Discover monsters, complete quests, conquer dungeons, collect legendary loot, and become the hero your world needs.

EXPLORE THE WORLD AROUND YOU
Using GPS technology, Orna transforms your surroundings into an ever-expanding fantasy world filled with monsters, dungeons, NPCs, quests, bosses, and hidden discoveries. Every place you visit has the potential to become part of your adventure.

No two journeys are ever the same.

STRATEGIC TURN-BASED RPG COMBAT
Every battle rewards planning and strategy.

Fight hundreds of unique monsters, conquer dangerous dungeons, challenge powerful world bosses, and master deep turn-based combat using weapons, spells, equipment, and abilities that evolve alongside your hero.

Whether you prefer careful tactics or overwhelming power, victory is earned through the choices you make.

BUILD YOUR HERO
Create a hero that's entirely your own.

Choose from more than 50 unique classes, each with its own specializations, skills, and playstyles. Become a mighty warrior, elusive thief, powerful mage, or experiment with countless class combinations to discover the build that suits you best.

Every new class unlocks new possibilities.

CONQUER DUNGEONS & EPIC RAIDS
Adventure into dangerous dungeons filled with monsters, puzzles, rare loot, and legendary bosses.

Take on enormous raid bosses alongside Travelers from around the world, earning powerful rewards and discovering new challenges with every monthly update.

JOIN A KINGDOM
Adventure is always better together.

Join a Kingdom to battle alongside players from across the globe in cooperative raids, Kingdom Wars, seasonal events, and community challenges. Whether you're a casual adventurer or a competitive player, you'll always have allies waiting.

BUILD YOUR ORIGIN TOWN
Create a home that's uniquely yours. Construct buildings, upgrade shops, improve your forge, and develop your Origin Town into the heart of your adventure. As your town grows, so do the opportunities available to every future journey.

JOIN THE TRAVELER'S GUILD
Your steps have never been more rewarding. Walking helps you discover new locations, encounter powerful enemies, uncover hidden rewards, and complete Traveler's Guild challenges as you explore the world around you.

Whether you're walking around the block or hiking your favourite trail, every step moves your adventure forward.

BEAUTIFUL RETRO PIXEL ART
Inspired by the golden era of classic RPGs, Orna combines handcrafted pixel art with modern online gameplay to create a timeless fantasy world filled with charm, nostalgia, and endless discovery.

Why Players Love Orna

• Explore a fantasy RPG built around the real world

• Discover dungeons, monsters, quests, and hidden treasures

• Battle challenging bosses using strategic turn-based combat

• Unlock more than 50 unique character classes

• Collect powerful weapons, equipment, and legendary loot

• Build and expand your own Origin Town

• Join Kingdoms for cooperative raids and competitive PvP

• Complete Traveler's Guild challenges while exploring outdoors

• Experience fresh monthly events, quests, and content updates

Official Subreddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/ Official Discord: http://discord.gg/orna Release notes: https://playorna.com/releases/ World data © OpenStreetMap (http://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright)

With frequent content updates, seasonal events, community challenges, and one of mobile gaming's most passionate player communities, there's always another reason to go outside and continue your journey.

Feast your eyes on eleven beautiful girls and try to win their affection. Find all of the hand-crafted stories and cutscenes for all characters in this game. Discover life stories and colorful personalities of each character while you get to know and help them in their daily life.
You decided to move to the town of Citampi to pay your parent’s debt and find happiness. 

However, you also found so much more in that place! You also found a lot of beautiful girls, friendly people, a wonderful neighborhood, and a place you can call home. Find your place in this pixel art – anime game. There is so much romance here you'll feel like you're trapped in a dating sim!
Propose and wed that special anime girl. You can find various types of girls here. From a shy and demure girl to a cheerful and sporty girl. From a classy uptown girl to a simple village girl.

But this is a lot more than just a visual novel. In this open-world RPG game, you can find various quirky jobs, a farming simulator, a crafting game, a pet simulator, treasure hunts, a fishing game, cooking game. This is a game about life and love!

Is that not enough for you? You can also turn your adventure into a fantasy story. Marry a ghost and meet with her supernatural friends. Have a ghostly child. Yikes!

A lot of things to do! All characters in Citampi Stories are full of stories. Discover the hand-made life stories and colorful personalities of each character while you get to know and help them in their daily life.

Have a family! The romance didn’t end after the wedding in our game. Do quests to improve your family life. Deliver fish and vegetables for your wife while she’s pregnant. Buy various dress-up costumes to keep her happy. Don’t forget to pay your utility bills to prevent blackouts. You can have an easy life or hard-working, fulfilling work.

Raise your child! Do different things while he/she grows from a baby, to a toddler, to a healthy boy/girl. Do various quests for your child and he/she will also help you.

Help your parent's farm. Raise farm animals and upgrade your parents' house. You can also build buildings all across Citampi for more abilities and features.

You’ll never run out of things to do in this anime role playing game!

Discover a lifetime of stories from a single guy, to a family man in this roleplay story. This is more than just a dating simulator, this is a life, simulated.

results.description:
The Animal wildlands is a dangerous RPG world, where the forest animals guard their territory while hunting and surviving off the land. For centuries, the wolf packs have remained at the top of the food chain, maintaining the natural order, led by their alpha, the last remaining dire wolf. When the dire wolf goes missing, you must lead your pack to greatness. Select a gray wolf or a black wolf, and start building your ultimate wolfpack. A wild life simulation adventure awaits!

Worldwide Multiplayer Battles - PvP

Fight for dominance in the virtual world! Take on the world in online real-time multiplayer PvP battles. Hunt together with your team in co-op and battle enemy clans to control the most territory. Will you be the hunter or the hunted?

Upgrade Your Battle Skills

Create your ultimate RPG hero - you can choose which skills to learn and upgrade. Unique skills range from basic MMORPG abilities to fantasy elemental attacks - and even stealth skills which allow you to hide in the forest and become the ultimate predator!

Breed & Raise Cubs

Build a family and role play! A realistic breeding sim gives cubs stronger fighting attributes compared to their parents. Take your pups out with you as you raid other clans and hunt your prey. Your pups will watch your every move, learning important survival and life skills. Trail your pup well, else they will not stand a chance in the online multiplayer PvP battle arena.

Collect Animals

The alpha is the hero of each pack. You can duel enemy clans and recruit their alpha to your den. Collect wolves, foxes, bears and other wild animals, each with realistic and fantasy evolution skins. Each creature is rendered in stunning 3D graphics.

Live The Story Of A Wolf Clan

A true survival simulator. When nature’s balance is threatened as the Great River has become contaminated, competition between the animals over the remaining spring water has begun. Even foreign tigers have been spotted far outside of their borders, causing concern amongst the rest of the animals.

There have also been rumours of ancient reptiles, rising to the surface from centuries of slumber, claiming the mountains and caves as their own. The gray wolves are now called upon to craft a solution in these troubled times.

A Massive Open World

Explore a huge, unbroken open MMO world teeming with wild life, from the dense forest, mountains to the freezing arctic. You can fight in online multiplayer PvP areas, tackle quests, role play, gather resources or raid enemy clans and take over their home. You might even encounter the tiger king on your adventure (a superior evolution of the natural tiger), who has been spotted in the forest for the first time in centuries!  

Groundbreaking 3D Graphics

Experience never before seen 3D graphics quality in a wildlife simulation MMO, with dynamic lighting and time of day cycles which bring the virtual world to life! Start your day at the mountain peaks, watching the sunrise with your pack before embarking on your adventure for survival and territory dominance.

Build & Decorate Your Den

Craft a home! Dig tunnels and secret passageways to expand your virtual family. Craft the best environment for your cubs, and raise a family to tackle the strongest predators in the forest. The realistic breeding simulator allows you to breed your animals and watch them grow to adults in real time.

results.description:
Build a life. Then build a legacy.

Everlife 2 is a generational life simulator about the person you want to become and every obstacle that gets in your way. Take control from birth to old age, one season at a time. Work on your grades. Make the wrong friend. Fall for someone unavailable. Take a job because rent is due. Build a life that is yours, even when it goes off the rails.

EVERY LIFE LEAVES SOMETHING BEHIND
When your character dies, read their obituary and choose what comes next. Start over, resurrect, or continue through the family tree, inheriting property, money, relationships, family history, and unfinished consequences.

CREATE SOMEONE. SEE WHO THEY BECOME.
Choose appearance, age, hometown, birthday, birth sign, family, backstory, traits, and physical conditions. The person you create shapes the people, opportunities, and problems they encounter. New traits can emerge through play, turning them into a nurturing parent, heartbreaker, workaholic, or something worse.

GROW UP YOUR WAY
Live through school with grades, cliques, clubs, friendships, family drama, and teen dating. Apply to college, choose housing and electives, join Greek life, study abroad, or take a summer job. Every stage opens new paths and opportunities.

MAKE A LIVING
Build a resume, search a changing job board, face interviews, and climb ten ranks across 35 career paths and 350 jobs. Education, skill, experience, and performance all matter. Get promoted, get fired, switch fields, earn a bonus, take a pay cut, or retire with a work history that reads like a life.

TURN TALENT INTO SOMETHING REAL
Develop more than 20 skills, then use them on projects with budgets, time commitments, difficulty, and real odds of failure. Write a novel, record an album, film a feature, build an app, launch a fashion line, restore a home, grow an exotic garden, or create a personal robot.

LOVE, FIGHT, FORGIVE, REPEAT
Make friends who last beyond the card that introduced them. Date, move in, propose, marry, cheat, divorce, reconcile, become estranged, or let an ex return with excellent timing and terrible intentions. Relationships shape future stories, household life, and the branches of your family tree.

RAISE A FAMILY
Plan a pregnancy, pursue donor IVF or surrogacy, adopt, or decide parenthood is not for this life. Every child has relationships and wellbeing of their own. Set rules, support them through school, navigate teen phases, and watch years of parenting shape the adult they become.

MAKE A HOME IN A WORLD THAT MOVES
Buy, build, sell, and flip property in a changing housing market. Add a studio, gym, nursery, or greenhouse, then live with lot traits that can make a home cozy, moldy, infested, or haunted. Buy vehicles whose condition affects their value. Adopt pets with their own ages, personalities, bonds, and wellbeing. Take vacations or move towns.

FACE THE HARD YEARS
Health problems can begin as symptoms before a diagnosis. Visit the doctor, weigh treatments that demand money, time, or follow-up care, and live with the consequences. Injuries, mental health struggles, cravings, relationship damage, and recovery can reshape a life.

MORE THAN 6,000 CARDS. OVER A MILLION WORDS.
Thousands of handwritten scenarios, actions, conversations, projects, and life moments span school, romance, work, family, health, housing, crime, fame, and the supernatural. Pursue Goals, collect Discoveries, unlock Achievements, and watch two lives that began in the same town end with almost nothing in common.

PLAY ON YOUR TERMS
Everlife 2 is free to download, fully offline, and has no ads, timers, or currencies.

One life is only the beginning.

How will you live your Everlife?

results.description:
NTE is a supernatural open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. The story begins in the city of Hethereau, where you play as its first "unlicensed" Anomaly Hunter. You'll join the crew at Eibon, a rundown antique shop that keeps the lights on by taking Anomaly commissions from anyone willing to pay. Alongside a diverse cast of extraordinary companions, you'll unravel urban mysteries, ride out adventures full of laughs and heartbreak, and write your own stories in the neon-lit streets.

◆ Strange City, Strange Adventures

Welcome to the first stop in your appraisal career—Hethereau, a sprawling and vibrant metropolis!

In the crowded halls of the Bureau of Anomaly Control, hopeful Oddities queue up for resident permits, while over at the train station, an Esper commuter snaps his fingers to clean his work suit on the fly. Down one block, a chaotic chase after Danzaburou is spiraling out of control; while across the street, a vacationing silver-gloved Butler is shooting the breeze  with the owner of a second-hand electronics shop. Everywhere you look, there's no shortage of intriguingly "abnormal" scenes.

Want to dive deeper into a world where humans and the supernatural coexist? Start your journey in Hethereau to see it for yourself. The lively and quirky daily life here is a grand adventure in itself.

◆ Interesting Stories, Lighthearted Connections

Today's Top Story: Rumors are swirling about a mysterious pawnshop that only appears on the night of the full moon. What would you trade for a wish?

Breaking News: Taygedo's romance crisis! Romance and impulse, heartbreak and missed chances—Miss Tako, the object of a secret crush, is about to leave Hethereau with her guarantor. How will the lovestruck otter get his feelings across before it's too late?

Reliable Insider Tip: Film Orbit Studio is back in business! Members of the Eibon Antique Shop get exclusive discounts!

Weather Update: The Anomaly Rainman is entering an active phase—don't forget your rain gear on the way out!

That wraps up today's 10AM broadcast. Stay tuned for mysterious Anomalies, unbreakable "Oaths," and the ever-growing shadow of the colossal "Circle" organization, looming larger in the fragmented echoes of "Prophecies"...

◆ Encounters and Bonds

Explore hidden shops tucked away in back alleys and meet their enigmatic owners, along with absurdly overpowered bodyguards, "jack-of-all-trades" robotic butlers, troublemakers who can't help finding problems, and TV-headed repairmen with some very curious eating habits.

As part of the Eibon crew, you'll never be short on energetic companions for the road ahead.

Expand your social circle starting from the bustling Hankaku Street! Meet members from different factions and add them as "Bagel" friends!

From the tight-knit neighborhood of street shops to the city's unique hunter organizations, countless side stories await—ready for you to make friends and forge bonds across every corner of Hethereau.

◆ Customize Your Urban Lifestyle

Explore the city on your own terms—stick to familiar routines or shake things up.

Customize your ride and tear through the city streets, or hop on the Ghost Train to cut through Anomaly space and arrive in a flash.

In your downtime, swing by the old shops on Hankaku Street to browse their secret seasonal stock, or buy a cozy little home and deck it out to your liking.

Go at your own pace, follow your instincts, and let Hethereau reward you with colorful days worth remembering.

results.description:
#1 Role playing game in 32 countries so far!

"You are Hope" is based on an earlier version of a PC game called "ONE HOUR ONE LIFE", made by Jason Rohrer.

It's not the same game though. You are Hope's gameplay and online worlds are separate from OHOL's, and the emphasis is more on the need to collaborate peacefully with other players in order to survive and evolve. Your task is to rebuild civilization from scratch, together with other players and across countless generations.

One important thing you do in this game is to name your children (who are also players). "You are Hope" is what a mother would say when she gives the name 'Hope' to her baby.

You are born either as a baby to one of the other players, or as a young woman if no suitable mother is found. Every minute of real time is one year in the game and your maximum age is 60 years. A single life is limited, but the things you make during your lifetime are left for your children and grandchildren once you are gone. Try to make life a little bit easier for those who come after you, so your family line will have a chance to prosper for generations to come.

Sometimes you will spawn alone in the wilderness. You need to build a fire to stay warm and trap rabbits to get meat and furs for clothes. A sharp stone may be your best friend in the beginning. Try to find a good spot to settle and grow some food, because other players may soon arrive as your children, and will need to be taken care of until they are grown enough to help you.

Sometimes you will be born in a sprawling city, with farmers, cooks, blacksmiths, shepherds and hunters. There will be clothes and equipment ready for you, prepared by players who may be your grandparents or distant relatives. Maybe you will gather some friends and set out to start a settlement of your own, maybe you will inherit a farm job from your uncle, or maybe you will slay bears and wolves. The choices are endless, but remember: unless you leave the world better after you have lived than when you arrived, you have not really achieved anything.

results.description:
Rogue with the Dead is an original roguelike RPG where you command and power up troops on an endless, looping journey.
What kills you makes you stronger.

An innovative game from room6, the team that has brought you such successes as Unreal Life and Gen’ei AP.


◆Defeat the Demon Lord
Your mission is to lead an envoy of soldiers for 300 miles, in order to defeat the Demon Lord at the end.
Completing quests and killing monsters will earn you coins that you can use to make your troops stronger.
They fight automatically, and you can choose to either wait and watch them have at it or join the battle yourself.

Soldiers respawn after they’re killed, but you don’t. You’ll lose all soldiers, money, and items, except for artifacts, and you’ll have to start over.

To stand a chance against the powerful bosses impeding your progress, you’ll need to collect as many artifacts as you can. Defeating them, in turn, will grant you more artifacts.


◆Many different playstyles
・Power up soldiers, defeat monsters, and clear dungeons
・An endless loop of dungeons
・Hire healers, summoners, magicians, and more to fight for you
・Focus on knights for close-range attacks or upgrade your wizards to crush enemies long-range? The choice is yours
・Defend yourself from the incoming enemies in true tower defense fashion
・Power up quests to earn more coins automatically in idle mode
・No annoying controls required as most of the game can be played while idling
・Find even stronger soldiers to defeat tough bosses
・Collect many useful artifacts
・Gather ingredients to cook meals to enhance your soldiers’ powers
・Compete with other players in the online leaderboard
・Roguelite mechanics, making you stronger every time you start over

◆A beautiful pixel art world
Travel through a fantastic world and its story drawn in beautiful pixel art. Enjoy the journey to the Demon Lord’s castle together with your troops and your guide Elly.
Little by little, you’ll find out about what happened before your arrival, and Elly might know more than she lets on...

◆Watch the numbers grow
At first, you’ll deal 10 or 100 points of damage. As you progress with the upgrades, the numbers will grow in the millions, billions, trillions... Enjoy the exponential growth of your power.

◆A varied roster of soldiers
Swordsman
A basic warrior unit with high health who fights on the front line to protect other soldiers.

Ranger
An archer that can attack from afar. However, it is slower and has less health than warriors.

Pigmy
A tiny warrior with low health and weak attack, but very fast movement. It can quickly sneak close to enemies to attack them directly.

Sorcerer
A magician that deals high damage to enemies within an area. However, it is slow and rather fragile.

...and many more.

◆Artifacts that power you up

・Increase attack by 50%
・Protect magicians from 1 attack
・Increase all coins earned by 50%
・1% of all soldiers' attack is added to the tap attack
・Soldiers have a 1% probability of spawning at giant size
・Necromancers can summon 1 additional skeleton

...and many more

◆If you’re tired, just idle
If you want to take a break, just close the game. Quests will still continue even while you’re not playing the game. When you come back, you’ll have more coins to power up your soldiers and defeat that boss that has been giving you trouble.
You can play for a few minutes at a time, so it’s perfect to fill in those little pockets of time throughout the day.


◆You’ll probably like this game if...
・You like idle games
・You like “clicker” games
・You want something to do in your spare time
・You like strategy games
・You like RPGs
・You like pixel art
・You want the game to progress while you're afk
・You like tower defense games
・You like roguelike or roguelite games
・You like playing online
・You like endless dungeon exploration games
・You like seeing numbers grow exponentially
・You go hard

That’s how the song goes, right? Well, now it does, seeing as how the apocalypse has come and gone and the last remaining survivors, yourself included, are left to rebuild society, starting with the local jail! Unexpected, yes, but just because the world got laid to waste doesn’t mean that all crime stopped. This game combines all the fun of idle games, where you’ll craft buildings, workbenches, and more that will collect resources for you in the background, with the fun of RPGs as you work to clean up the area, manage and expand the prison, and become an all-around jail tycoon. results.description:
Your life is the game. Level up for real.

Level Journey turns your habits, tasks and goals into an RPG. Every real thing you finish gives your hero XP and gold. Do a little every day and you grow, on screen and in real life.

Start playing in seconds. Pick what you want to grow, choose your hero and finish your first quest. You make an account only at the end, to save your hero.

NEW: THE WALK
• Your real steps fill a ring. Walk to the chests on it and open them for gold or an item.
• Past 10,000 steps a second ring opens. A weekly chest waits at 50,000 steps.
• A chest you reached is never lost. Steps come from Apple Health, read only.
• See your ring on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen with the widget.

YOUR HERO
• Choose from 9 heroes, free. Each one has its own look and colour.
• Spend gold on stats, and forge your weapon and armour to make them stronger.
• Level up all the way to 200, and unlock a specialization as you grow.

YOUR DAY
• Pick the areas of life you want to work on: fitness, mind, work, money and more.
• Each area has its own daily tasks. Tick one and the XP bar moves.
• Keep one daily rituals list for the things you do every day.
• Keep your streak alive. Streak freezes save it on a bad day.
• Tick tasks off from your Home Screen with the widget.

FIGHT
• Climb the Portal: 100 floors of monsters, each harder than the last.
• Travel the Map of realms, with its own monsters and quests.
• Finishing tasks can drop items. Sell them, or keep them for Map quests.
• Visit the Shop: three new offers every day, sometimes a Mystery Chest.

YOUR CIRCLE
• Join a Circle with friends and fight a boss together.
• Every task, ritual and goal step you finish loads a strike. Tap the boss to hit it.
• When everyone in the Circle fights on the same day, the boss takes an extra team hit.
• Chat, cheer each other on, and pick a crest for your Circle.
• A Circle is a team, not a ranking. You win together.

YOUR GOALS
• Write your goals as a numbered list, with the reason each one matters.
• Break them into steps and link your daily tasks to them.
• A short weekly review shows what moved.
• Set an Intention: one aim for 1 to 7 days, right at the top of your Goals. Hold to seal it each day. Bet gold on yourself if you want.
• The Journey Log keeps your calendar, your wins, your goals, your intentions and your walks.

LEVEL JOURNEY PRO
Everything above is free. PRO gives you more room and more ways to make the game yours:
• Track up to 12 life areas instead of 3
• Run up to 6 goals at once instead of 2
• Keep up to 10 things in your daily rituals instead of 6
• More item drops: 65% of tasks instead of 50%
• Change your hero any time
• The hero of the month, with their own weapon, armour and world
• Wear any hero, weapon and armour as your look. Your Circle sees it.
• Change the app colour, the app icon and your background
• Skip fights straight to the result

PRO is available as a monthly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. The yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial if you have not had one. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you turn them off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

results.description:
Exiled Kingdoms is a single player Action-RPG that allows you to roam freely through a unique world. It is an isometric game, inspired by some of the best role-playing games from the past decades; it brings back the old spirit of the classics in many ways: a challenging environment, choices with consequences, and a solid game system, with different paths to develop your character.

Explore the world: no one will point you to the best hidden secrets. Talk to hundreds of different characters, each with unique dialogues, and solve dozens of quests. Customize your character with dozens of skills and hundreds of different items. Overcome all kind of monsters and antagonists, choosing carefully the weapons or powers for each encounter. And return to the classical dungeon crawl, with traps and secret doors, and death awaiting the unwary adventurer behind every corner.

Forums and more information: http://www.exiledkingdoms.com

Free version: allows to play as a Warrior or a Rogue. It includes 30 areas, 29 completable quests and many hours of gameplay, with a level cap adequate to the areas available. 

Full version: requires a single in-app purchase, which unlocks everything, forever. No other activations are needed. Includes 135 areas, 90 quests (plus 200+ generated quests), hundreds of dialogues, counting over 130,000 words; approximately 120+ hours of gameplay, and more content gets added all the time. Additionally, the full version unlocks the Iron-Man mode (permadeath) and makes the Cleric and Mage classes available.

There are NO further micro-transactions. No pay-to-win, no "energy", no ads. Just a game, like they used to be.

STORY INTRODUCTION: A DARK TALE, AND A BRAVE NEW WORLD

A century ago, the Andorian Empire was destroyed by a magical cataclysm that brought The Horrors into our world; humanity was nearly annihilated. Many thousands managed to escape sailing away to the Imperial Colony of Varannar: a savage island, dangerous and unexplored. Mistrust and blame made impossible to elect a new Emperor, and the four Exiled Kingdoms were proclaimed.

Nowadays, the ragtag kingdoms still struggle to survive in a harsh land, often waging war on each other. Empire and the Horrors are, for many, just old legends and fairytales. You are a novice adventurer, rarely paying attention to such old stories; you're more concerned with your latest misadventures and lack of gold.

But for once, luck seems to be on your side. You received a letter from New Garand, stating that you are the sole beneficiary of a big inheritance. You don’t remember any relatives in the capital of the Kingdom of Varsilia, but certainly that won’t stop you from an opportunity like this! The road to New Garand will reveal many surprises, and will teach you that fairytales and legends can become, in fact, very real.

(*) Pathfinder Reference Document and System Reference Document. Check our website for information on included content.

results.description:
'Life is a Game' is a life simulation game where you see the life of a person from birth until death.

Thanks to many players' suggestions, the female main character is now available to play.
Play now to start a new life as a woman.

■■■■■Game Introduction■■■■■

'Life is a Game' is a running game.
Your life and appearance changes based on the type and 
amount of coins you obtain, and the choices you make using 
the Choice button throughout the game.

For example, if you painted a lot when you were a child,
your character develops into an artistic teenager and shows
their talents in art. If they play a musical instrument, there
is a higher chance that your character develops into a singer.

Also, you need to take care of your happiness and the relationships
you have with other people.

Experience the numerous ending scenes that change based on all of 
the decisions you make as a baby, as a child, as a teenager, as a man 
in his prime and as an elder.

*Tip: Adequately make use of the skills on the lower left.
Items purchased from the shop appear when certain conditions have
been met, so make sure to keep an eye out.

results.description:
Ghostbusters Wave 2 has arrived in Heroes vs. Hordes! Join Ray Stantz and Winston Zeddemore, summon the legendary Terror Dogs, and unleash spectral attacks with the new Ecto Goggles. Battle through new story chapters and collect returning Ghostbusters Heroes, Pets, and Weapons before this final event ends.

Heroes vs. Hordes: Survival RPG is the ultimate battle for survival in Midlantica, a fantasy world on the edge of annihilation. Heroes rise from every faction to face the relentless Horde — an ancient evil pouring through rifts between realms. Only your strategy, your upgrades, and your Heroes can hold back the darkness.

Survive the Horde
Endless enemies swarm the battlefield. With one-hand controls and real-time combat, every run is a test of reflexes and strategy. No idle auto-play — every dodge and upgrade is your choice.

Deep Strategy, Custom Builds
Over 100 heroes, weapons, and skills to unlock and master. Create unique loadouts, discover devastating synergies, and adapt each run to your playstyle — from armored tanks to explosive spellcasters.

Endless Progression
Loot, level, and upgrade with every fight. Heroes evolve, weapons forge into legendaries, and your squad grows stronger with each battle. The grind never ends — and neither does the thrill of mastery.

Explore the World of Midlantica
Journey through cursed forests, frozen wastelands, and arcane battlefields. Each chapter brings new enemies, hidden treasures, and epic boss encounters with unique attack patterns.

Multiple Game Modes
•  Campaign – Roguelite progression through story chapters and bosses
•  Adventure – Monthly 30-day events with exclusive heroes and weapons
•  Arena – Competitive weekend arenas with unique upgrade resources
•  Boss Brawl & Hero Clash – League challenges against rival players and titanic bosses
•  Guild Missions – Team up with allies to fight hordes and earn rewards

Play with the Community
Join millions of players around the world. Share builds, climb leaderboards, and push further with your guild. Heroes vs. Hordes isn’t just a game — it’s a squad.

Why Players Love Heroes vs. Hordes
•  100+ unlockable heroes, weapons, and skills
•  Endless waves of enemies and epic boss fights
•  Strategy-driven roguelite progression
•  Monthly events and fresh content
•  Built for community with guilds, leaderboards, and co-op missions

Midlantica’s fate rests in your hands. Can you outlast the endless horde and become a legend? Download Heroes vs. Hordes today and begin your fight.

Follow us on Instagram: instagram.com/heroesvshordes
Follow us on X: x.com/heroesvhordes

results.description:
Forge and equip weapons from different civilizations! Start by forging gear from the Stone Age. Then upgrade your anvil in order to forge gear from the Medieval Age. Work your way up to the Modern Age, Space Age and even up to the Quantum Age! 

Are you ready for this adventure?

Forge, Upgrade, and Compete Across the Ages!

Step into an online world where progress never stops. In this competitive multiplayer game, you’ll forge weapons and armor from different civilizations, research new technologies, train pets, and climb the global leaderboard.

Forge Gear Through the Ages

Start in the Stone Age and forge your first weapons and armor in your anvil. As you play, upgrade your forge to unlock new materials, designs, and powerful equipment from the Medieval, Modern, Space, and Quantum Ages. Each upgrade takes you further through time and closer to the top of the competition.

Compete with Other Players

Challenge players from around the world in online battles. Equip your best gear, use your hero’s unique abilities, and test your strength against others. Every win earns rewards and helps you climb the global leaderboard — or represent your clan in team competitions.

Research and Progress

Unlock new technologies in your tech tree to gain advantages in battle and crafting. Discover new forging methods, boost your hero’s stats, and improve your overall efficiency as you move through each age.

Develop Your Hero

Customize your hero’s playstyle by unlocking and upgrading skills. Choose your approach - faster attacks, stronger defenses, or smarter strategies and experiment to find the combination that works best for you.

Collect and Train Pets

Hatch and train pets that fight alongside you. Each pet has unique traits and abilities that enhance your performance in battles. Strengthen them over time to build the perfect support team.

Form Clans and Compete Together

Join or create a clan to collaborate with other players. Exchange tips, coordinate strategies, and participate in clan competitions for shared rewards. The most active clans earn their place on the Clan Leaderboard.

Chat and Connect

Use the chat system to talk with other players in real time. Discuss tactics, plan clan battles, or just hang out and share your progress. The community is always active, there’s always someone online to compete with or learn from.

Forge your path through history, unlock new eras of technology, and prove your skill in this ever-evolving online game.

Start forging today and see how far your hero can go!

06.08.2026 ver7 updated! An Idle RPG You Can Enjoy Even on Busy Days!
The gameplay is super simple. Equip your adventurer and send them off to the dungeon. After that, even if you close the game, the adventure will automatically progress.
Enjoy an epic adventure while focusing on work, housework, or studying!


[Objective of the Game]
Your mission is to defeat the Demon King who rules the world!
In this world, there is a “Demon King’s Curse” that resets the adventurer’s level to 1 after every dungeon cleared.
The Demon King dominates the world with this powerful curse.
That's why your actions to support the adventurer are key to victory.


[How to Play]
Send your adventurer to the dungeon.
Even if you close the game, the adventure will automatically progress, and you will acquire items and equipment.
Customize your adventurer's appearance and abilities to enjoy a unique adventure!


[Hints for Success]
1. Make sure to strengthen your equipment before challenging high-difficulty dungeons! You’ll have the chance to acquire even more powerful gear!
2. Some equipment can evolve into stronger weapons as you continue to upgrade them!
3. If you get stuck or need hints, check the in-game messages from Supporter Teba, or join the fan community on Discord!


[Main Features]
Idle RPG
 The adventure continues automatically even when the game is closed. You can enjoy the game while valuing your daily life.
Hack-and-Slash Elements
 Strengthen your equipment and challenge stronger enemies! Hack-and-slash and roguelike fans will be satisfied with the deep replayability.
Adventurer Customization
 Change the appearance and abilities freely and enjoy adventuring with your favorite character!
Growth and Replayability
 With over 160 types of equipment, 200+ special abilities, and more than 10 permanent boosts, you can create the strongest adventurer of your own!


The app supports VoiceOver (text-to-speech) functionality.
If you enjoy the game, please leave a review on the store! Feel free to send feedback via email or X.

Adventure into the wilderness on a hunt for Amikins, mystical creatures with unmatched powers and endearing personalities. 'Amikin Village' blends the cuteness and whimsy of anime with the strategic depth of RPG games, all while packing a punch of humor with its meme magic. Revel in light-hearted adventures and chuckles over nods to popular culture, making your journey one filled with laughter and joy.

results.description:
Welcome to the World of Power, Betrayal, and Crime

Mafia Life is a dark, immersive game where you begin as a member of a mafia family. Your goal is simple: rise in power, climb the family ranks, defeat your enemies, and ultimately become the Godfather who controls the entire underworld.


Strategy, Choices, and Ascension
Join a mafia family and dive into a web of loyalty, betrayal, power, and politics. Rising through the ranks isn’t just about brute force — it’s about smart decisions. Who you trust and who you eliminate is up to you.


Combat and Domination
From one-on-one fights to large-scale mafia wars, countless battles await. The strength of your family, your soldiers, and your decisions will determine your victory. Win and gain respect — lose, and risk losing everything.


Missions and Criminal Empire
Crime is your daily routine: extortion, drug manufacturing, car theft, or bank heists. The bigger the risk, the bigger the reward. Use your earnings to buy properties, cars, and weapons — build wealth and reputation.


Family Ties and Intrigue
Mafia Life is more than just violence; it's an emotional and social experience filled with relationships, marriages, betrayals, and inheritance drama. Love, have children, or face betrayal. Every choice shapes your legacy.


Diplomacy and Territory Wars
Relationships with other mafia families shape the game world. Will you make peace or start a war? Each decision shifts the balance of power. Conquer enemy territories to expand your influence — but beware, attacks can come at any moment.


Luck, Events, and Surprises
Random events, surprise visitors, and sudden crises keep the game world alive and unpredictable. It's a constant dance between danger and opportunity.


Achievements and Becoming a Legend
Lots of achievements await. Win battles, complete missions, dominate the map, build a loyal family — or walk the path of a lone legend. Every decision is a chance to write your own mafia story.

results.description:
Improve mental health, resilience and social-emotional skills.
 
SuperBetter is at heart a simple and transformative idea – we can use the same strengths naturally displayed in game play to confront real-life challenges, build skills, manage stress & practice self-care.
 
SuperBetter uses the psychology of game play in all of life. Playing SuperBetter means bringing a gameful mindset to real-life - challenging yourself, going for epic wins, adopting a secret identity, completing quests, battling bad guys, activating power-ups and checking-in with allies. The 7 rules for living gamefully is a framework to be stronger, happier, braver & more resilient in everyday life.
 
Invented by researcher & game designer Jane McGonigal, SuperBetter is backed by science. In a randomized controlled trial at University of Pennsylvania playing SuperBetter for 30 days was associated with significant improvements in mental health and resilience.
 
The SuperBetter app makes it simple to go for epic wins, track your gameful strengths and build your whole-person resilience - mental, social, emotional & physical. Proven results in 10 minutes a day.
 
SuperBetter is for youth, teens, young adults & everyone who wants to unlock their heroic potential using the power of living gamefully. Over 1 million people have played SuperBetter.
 
SUPERBETTER PRODUCTS
 
> Hero account:    Play SuperBetter on your own.
> Host account:    A web-based portal to host challenges for squads.
> Player account: Join squad challenges when invited by a host.
 
HERO ACCOUNT: PLAY ON YOUR OWN
 
14-day free trial
 
Grow your mental health, social-emotional wellbeing & physical resilience with a library of over 40 solo challenges.
 
Create your own challenges to go for personal epic wins.
 
Join squad challenges from hosts.
 
Watch a demo video on the SuperBetter website.
 
HOST ACCOUNT: HOST CHALLENGES FOR SQUADS
 
Promote mental health, resilience, social-emotional learning and skills for success with groups in a way that's practical & engaging.
 
Designed for educators, the Host account is available to anyone:
 
> Middle & high school teachers promote social-emotional learning.
> Small groups, teams & clubs foster youth mental health & resilience.
> Universities empower student success & student wellbeing.
> Small businesses make it a low-cost employee wellbeing program.
 
The web-based host portal makes it easy to create squads & host challenges. Squad challenges bring the SuperBetter methodology to life. Each has an epic win and 5-days of activities. Hosts select from a library of over 90 challenges to promote mental, emotional, social & physical resilience, or create custom challenges to have squads go for any epic win they choose. Squad members play about 10 minutes a day on the SuperBetter mobile or web app. They use a free Player account or a low-cost Hero account. Learn more on the SuperBetter website.
 
PLAYER ACCOUNT: SQUAD PLAY ONLY
 
The Player account is a companion to the Host account. It is a free account to play with squads only.
 
Players can join squad challenges when invited by someone with a Host account, and play a weekly challenge hosted by SuperBetter.
 
DESIGNED FOR SMARTPHONES
 
The SuperBetter mobile app is designed for smartphones. If you have a Chromebook, iPad or tablet device you can play on the web app.
 
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
 
The Hero account price is $24.99 per year.
 
Pricing is for U.S. customers. Pricing in other countries may vary. Charges may be converted to local currency depending on country of residence.
 
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled before the end of the current subscription period. Manage your subscription in Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
